positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheaded a data pipeline project crucial to the success of the Enview, the startup's only product.

Worked with a team of engineers to ingest data from various third-party sources for use in an early-stage legislation tracking application.

Designed and implemented key workflow processes such as task prioritization and assignment, code reviews, and incident management.

Identified project risks and potential mitigation strategies to CTO and senior leadership. Worked with team to execute the recommended solutions for delivering maximum value within tight timeline and resource constraints.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote, tested, and reviewed code to implement features for the Drinkworks.com website and e-commerce platform.

Designed and built prototype for an in-house article and knowledge management database for a fortune 500 company. Partnered with clients, designers, and engineers to gather and document requirements. Built MVP from scratch according to mock-up specifications.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked as an integral member of a software product team to develop a sports betting mobile application for the company’s largest client. Technology stack included React Native in Typescript, Redux, PostgreSQL, Firestore, GraphQL, and third-party APIs.

Employed agile methodology within a peer review workflow framework to develop, test, review, and deploy high-quality code to implement features per documented designs.

Updated legacy codebase to align with industry best practices and company coding standards.
Partnered with senior management and other developers to design, document, and implement more inclusive hiring processes for engineer candidates following recommendations set forth by Project Include.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Completed a solo capstone project designed to simultaneously reduce food waste and hunger by matching excess food at restaurants with soup kitchen demand. The app allows users at restaurants to post excess food items that would otherwise go to waste. Users at soup kitchens can view, claim, and rescue the donated food for distribution to food insecure families and individuals. Technologies used: React, Redux, Redux-Saga, Node, Express, PostgreSQL, Material-UI, Passport authentication middleware, and various other JavaScript libraries.

Worked with four teammates to develop a public-facing data visualization web application for the Center for Economic Inclusion, a non-profit organization dedicated to advancing inclusive growth in the Twin Cities in order to achieve regional prosperity. As the most senior engineer on the project, my role on the team included tasks ranging from leading client interactions and mentoring teammates to architecting and  constructing the application’s database.

patents.title: Pellet systems for preparing beverages
patents.description: Methods, compositions, and articles of manufacture for preparing frozen beverages are described. The methods and articles generally include first and/or second frozen pellets. Upon mixing the frozen pellets with an appropriate liquid for a sufficient time, a frozen beverage is obtained. Articles of manufacture including frozen pellets, as well as optional objects such as straws, spoons, and mixing containers are disclosed. Methods, compositions, and articles of manufacture for preparing frozen pellets are also described.
